title: 2017 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: Mary thought of a positive two-digit number. She multiplied it by \(3\) and added \(11.\) Then she switched the digits of the result, obtaining a number between \(71\) and \(75,\) inclusive. What was Mary’s number?

solutions.text:
Work backward from the possible results. Reversing \(71,72,73,74,75\) gives \(17,27,37,47,57,\) respectively. Subtracting \(11\) gives \(6,16,26,36,46.\) Only \(6\) and \(36\) are divisible by \(3,\) and only \(36\div3=12\) is a two-digit number.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Work backward from the possible reversed results
After reversing and subtracting \(11\), check divisibility by \(3\)
